'''Anya''' is a servant in the [[Aesdaishar Palace]] in [[Chachin]].

==Appearance==
Anya is a square-faced woman with gray hair.

==History==
Anya is possibly [[Esne]]'s mother. She and Esne were assigned to be [[Lan Mandragoran]]'s serving women when he came to the Palace in {{ne|979}}.{{ref/book|0|22}} She delivered him messages from the Lady [[Edeyn Arrel]]. Lan discovers that Anya and Esne are loyal to Edeyn after a little searching.
